system.description: Moldwretch forms symbiosis with other molds nearby, spreading their spores with its attack. Brown. Moldwretch is immune to fire, +[[/r 1d6]] damage. Russet. [[check 12 con]] or [[/r 1d4]] CON damage (can't heal while ill). Repeat check once per day; ends on success. Die at 0 CON and spawn vegepygmy. Yellow. [[check 12 con]] or 1 CON damage (can't heal while ill). Repeat check once per round; ends on success.
